title: FreshCut lexicon — what a tap actually is (concept §4, Ledger 2026-09-24)
description: 61 fragments (12 category + 8 taste + 6 energy + 9 world + 8 material + 6 type + 6 sound + 6 cta) plus a conflict table. Owned by the content agent; stored and versioned by Claude Code. Changing a fragment changes every FUTURE kit's prompts; it never touches a built kit.

lexicon_version.description: Semver. Every brief records the version it was merged under.

taste.description: S2 — 8 house-stinger archetypes: SNAP GLIDE STRIKE BLOOM SHUTTER GRAIN CHROME PULSE. Strongest signal in the flow.

energy.description: S3 — Chill Steady Punchy Hype Cinematic Playful.

world.description: S4 — 9 swatch-scenes; logo palette is a 10th, runtime-generated swatch, never a lexicon entry.

material.description: S5 — Glass Metal Paper Neon tube Smoke Film grain Clean flat Chrome.

type.description: S6 — Bold block, Elegant serif, Mono/tech, Handwritten, Condensed sport, Rounded friendly.

sound.description: S7 — Sub hum, Riser+hit, Vinyl warm, Synth pulse, Drum hit, Silence.

cta.description: S8 — Follow Subscribe Link Shop Book/DM Sponsor slot.

conflicts.description: Explicit resolution rules. Evaluated in order; first match wins per slot. A rule never refuses a tap silently — it substitutes and notes it on the brief.

most.description: S2 only: long-press marks one pick as 'most'.

default.description: Fragment id applied when the screen is SKIPPED (the safe reading).

label.description: The ONE word revealed on long-press. Never shown by default.

glyph.description: Asset ref: original FreshCut glyph (S1/S3/S7/S8) or motion loop (S2/S4/S5) or type tile (S6).

wildcard.description: S1 '?' only — flags the brief WILDCARD; taste becomes the primary signal.

slots.description: The five prompt-vocabulary slots. A fragment may leave a slot empty (null) when the dimension has no opinion there.

motion.description: Slot 1 — motion verbs: how things enter, hold, leave.

palette.description: Slot 2 — palette rule, DESCRIBED, never coded. No hex anywhere.

material.description: Slot 3 — surface and how light meets it.

sound.description: Slot 4 — bed character, hit character, silence.

prefers.description: Fragment ids in OTHER dimensions this one favours (e.g. comedy prefers paper, clean_flat).

refuses.description: Fragment ids in OTHER dimensions this one refuses; a refusal MUST have a matching conflict rule that substitutes.

prompt_notes.description: Free text for the prompt writer only; never rendered to the client.

when.description: Fragment ids that must all be present in the brief (e.g. ['comedy','cinematic']).

value.description: Replacement slot text (override_slot / soften) or replacement fragment id (substitute_fragment).

note.description: Appended to brief.conflicts_resolved so the operator sees what moved and why.
